item.title: December 1.0 (114)
item.description:
## What's new
- **A newer terminal engine.** The embedded terminal runs on Ghostty 1.4.0: better scrollback and memory use, more reliable redraws, and a long list of fixes for full-screen programs, tmux and Kitty graphics. - **Links open only where they should.** A link printed by a program can no longer launch a local file or a custom URL handler through December. Web and mail links open in the usual apps; file links are revealed in the file pane instead, and other schemes are ignored. - **Drops are safer.** File drops still paste shell-quoted paths without pressing Enter, but now go through the terminal's protected paste. Text and image drops use the same path, and December records the drop as input so prompt-safety stays correct. - **The download carries its own ticket.** The app inside the disk image is now notarized and stapled separately, so macOS can verify it offline after an update or if you move it out of the image.
